raw_text: Breaking: Multiple Indian embassies in Europe hit by coordinated cyber attack. Sources say APT28 (Fancy Bear) is behind the operation. Spear-phishing emails with malicious PDFs sent to diplomatic staff. Sensitive data reportedly exfiltrated including diplomatic cables. CERT-In team deployed to affected missions. Russian intelligence services suspected.
